statement: Tip one: earn free gems each day and week since there are several ways to get them.
Buy One Measly Gem and A Pair of Gems in the Liquid Shop twice each day each for 6 gems daily, 42 weekly.
Fighting daily World 2 mini bosses gives 12 gems a day or 84 a week if you have the World 2 merit.
The World 2 merit is needed to get gems from bosses.
Using each daily key to fight bosses can give 20 gems a day or 140 a week.
Completing the daily Spiketrap minigame gives 5 gems a day or 35 a week.
Guild gift boxes each week can give about 125 gems if you are in a guild.
Unlocking the Tachion of the Titans prayer in World 3 spawns giants that give about 100 gems a week.
The World 4 colosseum can give about 80 gems each week.
Maestro talent It's Your Birthday has a chance of giving gems each day.
Keeping up with all these sources gains about 600 gems each week.
Do mini-games every day since they are among the fastest ways to level a skill and gain quick resources.
A few mini-game runs are among the best ways to level skills on characters that do not specialize in that skill.
Mini-game runs take only minutes each day and give some of the best EXP per hour possible for any skill.
Plan your characters early because each class specializes in a skill.
You'll eventually need 2 of each base class: Warrior Archer and Mage.
Barbarian specializes in Fishing.
Squire specializes in Mining and Construction.
Bowman specializes in Catching.
Hunter specializes in Trapping.
Shaman specializes in Alchemy and Chopping.
Wizard specializes in Worship and Chopping.
Don't hyper focus damage; IdleOn is incremental and everything you do adds up to increased gains.
Alchemy gives bonuses to almost everything in the game.
Post Office has targeted bonuses depending on what you want.
Gathering is needed to improve your gear.
Focusing too much on one aspect leads to hitting a wall and slows progress in the long run.
Offline fighting has a cap on how much attack skills can increase AFK gains.
Each attack skill talent point multiplies a hidden number; at 2.2x kills per hour AFK gains stop increasing around 25 points.
Cap talent points on attack skills at about 25 each and don't put more.
Turn on Use Attacks During Auto in options so taskbar attacks are used while AFK or offline.
Every skill level gives a talent point.
Level 10 in all 12 skills gives 120 talent points per tree on that character.
Don't ignore skills since they're required to increase gear and their resources feed Alchemy and Stamps.
It's fairly easy to get level 10 or 20 in every skill even on non-specialist characters.
Always check your AFK gain menu for kills per hour and EXP per hour.
The highest monster you can fight isn't always the best for EXP.
With many buffs it's easy to forget something inactive or use the wrong talent preset which massively affects AFK gains.
Don't be afraid to use food since defense eventually can't keep up with the monster's requirement for zero damage.
Needing food to continue progressing is absolutely normal; get as much defense as you can anyway.
He started using food in World 2 while his Squire was farming gold for gear.
Hemoglobin talent greatly increases survivability and is unlocked with merit points in the World 1 task board.
Start doing a few dungeon runs each week as early as you can.
Dungeon stats are entirely separate from your character outside the dungeon except talent points so you needn't be strong.
You gain charges weekly shown top left and each dungeon run spends one to increase rewards.
Dungeon Happy Hour can spend up to 20 charges to give 20 times the rewards.
Dungeon rewards are credits flurbos and keychains.
Dungeon credits increase your stats during the dungeon.
Flurbos increase your stats outside dungeons.
Keychains are special equipment giving percent to stats or percent to AFK gain rates.
Don't focus on money; coins are among the least used currencies and materials and drops are needed far more.
Later maps drop coins in much higher quantities making Alchemy and Stamps easier to level the further you progress.
